title: Recipe
description: A per-tenant/per-source instantiation of a connector. Hundreds to thousands of these. Declarative YAML, schema-validated, contributable by community (doc 16 §17.4, doc 18 §3).

connector.description: id of the connector this recipe instantiates

version.description: recipe_version — runs are tagged with this; bump to roll forward/back (doc 18 §3.5)

entity.description: How normalize() resolves the producing entity (doc 18 §2.4).

entity_id.description: stable external id (NCES, IPEDS, FIPS, UEI) — preferred

tenant.description: Per-tenant overrides for multi-tenant platform connectors (e.g. subdomain).

schedule.description: Per-recipe cadence. The scheduler (TODO D4) reads `cron`; the runner's fetch step reads `fetch.politeness_seconds` to space same-host requests (doc 18 §2.2).

cron.description: cron expression for the scheduled run cadence

fetch.description: Fetch-time politeness and legal posture (doc 18 §2.2, doc 16 §18). Overrides the connector descriptor's rate_limit defaults.

respect_robots_txt.description: Honor the source's robots.txt. Recipes that disable this are rejected in PR review (doc 16 §18); the field exists so the posture is explicit and auditable.

politeness_seconds.description: Minimum delay between requests to the same host (doc 18 §2.2). Default 10s; configurable upward.

jitter_seconds.description: Random extra delay (0..jitter) added before every request (independent of the politeness wait) to avoid lockstep request patterns across recipes.

user_agent.description: Identified bot UA (doc 16 §18). Defaults to the platform UA when omitted.

max_redirects.description: Cap redirects to fail visibly on redirect loops (doc 18 §4, static-HTML).

prefilter.description: assume_relevant skips the Stage-2 relevance classifier for pre-vetted sources (doc 19 §3).

connector_config.description: Per-connector configuration block (doc 18 §1, §5 wave 1, TODO D6). The runner dispatches to the connector named by `connector` and validates this block against that connector's sub-schema. Exactly one sub-key (matching `connector`) is expected; an unknown connector or extra key is rejected so a typo can't silently degrade to no-op.

http_static.description: Generic HTTP fetcher (doc 18 §1 cat. C). Retries/backoff and conditional GET on top of the runner's robots.txt + politeness window.

max_attempts.description: Total fetch attempts (incl. the first) on transient HTTP 5xx / network errors (doc 18 §4).

backoff_seconds.description: Base for exponential backoff between retries.

conditional_get.description: Send If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since when a prior ETag / Last-Modified is known (doc 18 §2.2 step 3).

rss.description: RSS/Atom feed connector (doc 18 §1 cat. B). discover() parses the feed and emits one pointer per item.

feed_url.description: Feed URL to discover items from. Defaults to the recipe's seed URL when omitted.

max_items.description: Cap items discovered per run (newest first).

fetch_item_body.description: Fetch each item's linked article (cat. B). When false, only the feed entry fields are used (doc 18 §4 'Article URLs no longer resolve').

pdf_extractor.description: PDF text extraction chain (doc 18 §1 cat. F): pdfplumber text → OCR fallback → LLM table extraction. Consumed by other connectors, not scheduled directly.

ocr_fallback.description: Run OCR when the PDF has no extractable text layer (image-only PDF; doc 18 §4).

llm_table_fallback.description: After text/OCR, ask the LLM gateway to extract tables when they parse poorly (doc 18 §4).

rest_api_pager.description: REST/JSON client (doc 18 §1 cat. A) with pagination, auth, and rate limiting.

pagination.description: How to advance through pages (doc 18 §2.1 REST).

mode.description: cursor: follow a next-cursor token; offset: bump an offset param; page: bump a page-number param.

items_path.description: Dotted path to the array of records in each response.

cursor_path.description: Dotted path to the next-cursor token (cursor mode).

cursor_param.description: Query param carrying the cursor (cursor mode).

offset_param.description: Query param carrying the offset (offset mode).

page_param.description: Query param carrying the page number (page mode).

limit_param.description: Query param carrying the page size.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked per run.

auth.description: Auth applied to every request (doc 18 §2.2 step 2). The secret is the literal value or an `env:NAME` reference resolved from the environment (never the plaintext key in committed YAML).

header.description: Header name for api_key mode (e.g. X-Api-Key).

value.description: The literal secret, or `env:NAME` to read it from the environment at run time.

bulk_download.description: Periodic file fetch (doc 18 §1 cat. G) with per-file checkpointing so re-runs only process new data.

format.description: File format hint; inferred from the URL/Content-Type when omitted.

checkpoint_strategy.description: How discover() decides the file is unchanged (doc 18 §2.1 bulk): conditional ETag/Last-Modified header, or a content hash compared to the stored marker.

socrata.description: Socrata SODA open-data API (doc 18 §1 cat. E, §5 wave 2). One connector covers hundreds of city/state portals; this block selects a tenant + dataset. discover() pages the SODA endpoint and emits one pointer per row, projected to an HTML <dl> the recipe's `fields` extract with `dd[data-key='<column>']`.

domain.description: Portal domain or full base URL, e.g. `data.cityofnewyork.us` or `https://data.colorado.gov`.

order.description: Optional SoQL $order clause for deterministic paging.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked per run.

app_token.description: Socrata app token, literal or `env:NAME` (optional; lifts the anonymous rate limit). Sent as the X-App-Token header.

ckan.description: CKAN open-data catalog API (doc 18 §1 cat. E, §5 wave 2). One connector covers Data.gov + many state/city catalogs; this block selects a tenant + datastore resource. discover() pages /api/3/action/datastore_search and emits one pointer per record, projected to an HTML <dl> the recipe's `fields` extract with `dd[data-key='<field>']`.

domain.description: Catalog domain or full base URL, e.g. `catalog.data.gov` or `https://data.wa.gov`.

q.description: Optional full-text filter passed to datastore_search `q`.

filters.description: Optional CKAN `filters` object (field -> value), serialized to JSON.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked per run.

api_key.description: CKAN API key for private datasets, literal or `env:NAME`. Sent as the Authorization header.

arcgis_rest.description: Esri ArcGIS REST query API (doc 18 §1 cat. E, §5 wave 2). One connector covers Esri-hosted GIS/tabular layers; this block selects a layer. discover() pages the layer /query endpoint and emits one pointer per feature (attributes flattened), projected to an HTML <dl> the recipe's `fields` extract with `dd[data-key='<field>']`.

where.description: SQL-style where clause; `1=1` fetches all rows.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked per run.

include_geometry.description: Keep each feature's geometry (returnGeometry); off by default — we want the tabular attributes.

token.description: Token for secured ArcGIS services, literal or `env:NAME`. Sent as the `token` query param.

boarddocs.description: BoardDocs (Diligent) meeting platform (doc 18 §1 cat. E, §5 wave 2). One connector covers ~10,000 K-12/community-college boards via the per-tenant subdomain pattern. discover() crawls the tenant's meeting index and emits one pointer per meeting detail page for the runner to fetch + extract.

base_url.description: Full tenant base URL (overrides state+subdomain), e.g. `https://go.boarddocs.com/wa/spsk12`.

state.description: Two-letter state segment of the BoardDocs URL (e.g. `wa`). Used with `subdomain`.

subdomain.description: Tenant subdomain segment of the BoardDocs URL (e.g. `spsk12`). Used with `state`.

meeting_path.description: Index path appended to the tenant base when crawling for meeting links.

granicus_peak.description: Granicus PEAK meeting platform (doc 18 §1 cat. E, §5 wave 2). One connector covers 7,000+ government orgs via the per-tenant subdomain pattern. discover() crawls the tenant's PEAK meeting archive and emits one pointer per meeting/agenda detail page.

base_url.description: Full tenant base URL (overrides subdomain), e.g. `https://seattle.granicus.com`.

view_id.description: PEAK ViewPublisher view_id for the meeting archive (optional).

meeting_path.description: Archive path appended to the tenant base when crawling for meeting links.

civicplus.description: CivicPlus / CivicClerk municipal platform (doc 18 §1 cat. E, §5 wave 2). One connector covers 2,500+ local governments. discover() crawls the tenant's meeting/agenda index and emits one pointer per detail page. A tenant whose list renders only client-side is a per-recipe http_browser (D9) decision, noted in legal_notes — not handled here.

base_url.description: Full tenant base URL (overrides subdomain+platform), e.g. `https://townofx.civicweb.net`.

platform.description: Which CivicPlus host family the tenant uses.

meeting_path.description: Index path appended to the tenant base when crawling for meeting links.

usaspending.description: USAspending.gov award API (doc 18 §1 cat. A, §5 wave 3). Free, keyless federal spending API; discover() pages the award-search endpoint (results under `results`, advanced via `page_metadata.hasNext`) and emits one pointer per award projected to an HTML <dl> the recipe's `fields` extract with `dd[data-key='<field>']`.

base_url.description: API base host (defaults to the public production host).

endpoint.description: Award-search endpoint path appended to base_url.

query_params.description: Extra query params scoping the search (award_type_codes, recipient_id, …), passed verbatim.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked per run.

gdelt.description: GDELT 2.0 DOC news API (doc 18 §1 cat. A, §5 wave 3). Free, keyless news-article search; discover() issues one time-windowed query (no pagination) and emits one pointer per article (under `articles`) projected to an HTML <dl> the recipe's `fields` extract with `dd[data-key='<field>']`.

query.description: GDELT boolean search expression (e.g. `"school district" sourcecountry:US`).

max_records.description: Cap on articles returned by the single query (GDELT `maxrecords`).

bonfire_euna.description: Bonfire / Euna Supplier Network procurement (doc 18 §1 cat. E, §5 wave 3). Multi-tenant e-procurement platform; this block selects a tenant portal. discover() pages the tenant's public opportunity-listing data API and emits one pointer per opportunity projected to an HTML <dl> the recipe's `fields` extract with `dd[data-key='<field>']`. Public listings only — login-gated tenants are rejected in PR review (doc 16 §18).

listing_path.description: Public opportunity-listing API path appended to portal_url.

items_path.description: Dotted path to the opportunities array in the response envelope.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked per run.

ionwave.description: IonWave e-procurement platform (doc 18 §1 cat. E, §5 wave 3). Multi-tenant platform popular with school districts and small local governments; this block selects a tenant portal. discover() pages the tenant's public bid-listing data API and emits one pointer per bid projected to an HTML <dl> the recipe's `fields` extract with `dd[data-key='<field>']`.

listing_path.description: Public bid-listing API path appended to portal_url.

items_path.description: Dotted path to the bids array in the response envelope.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked per run.

nces_ccd.description: NCES Common Core of Data — K-12 entity-directory bulk import (doc 18 §1 cat. G, §5 wave 3). An entity directory, not a signal stream; normalize() resolves rows to K-12 entities by NCES id. Checkpointed download (zero pointers when unchanged).

file_url.description: Bulk file URL (defaults to the current CCD directory file); override to pin a school-year vintage.

format.description: File format hint (federal directory dumps ship as zip).

checkpoint_strategy.description: How discover() decides the file is unchanged (doc 18 §2.1 bulk).

ipeds.description: IPEDS — higher-ed entity-directory bulk import (doc 18 §1 cat. G, §5 wave 3). An entity directory, not a signal stream; normalize() resolves rows to higher-ed entities by IPEDS unit id. Checkpointed download (zero pointers when unchanged).

file_url.description: Bulk file URL (defaults to the current IPEDS HD directory file); override to pin a survey year.

format.description: File format hint (federal directory dumps ship as zip).

checkpoint_strategy.description: How discover() decides the file is unchanged (doc 18 §2.1 bulk).

census_gov.description: Census of Governments — all-government entity-directory bulk import (doc 18 §1 cat. G, §5 wave 3). ~90,000 entities; an entity directory, not a signal stream; normalize() resolves rows by FIPS code. Checkpointed download (zero pointers when unchanged).

file_url.description: Bulk file URL (defaults to the published government-units file); override to pin a census-year vintage.

format.description: File format hint (federal directory dumps ship as zip).

checkpoint_strategy.description: How discover() decides the file is unchanged (doc 18 §2.1 bulk).

samgov.description: SAM.gov opportunities — DEFERRED TO V2 (doc 18 §5 wave 3 #12). Federal coverage is out of MVP scope (TODO.md 'Out of scope'); this connector is registered but not wired for live fetching (discover() emits no pointers). The block is intentionally permissive so a forward-looking recipe documenting intended v2 coverage still validates. # TODO v2.

Federal coverage is out of MVP scope (TODO.md 'Out of scope'); this connector is registered but not wired for live fetching (discover() emits no pointers). The block is intentionally permissive so a forward-looking recipe documenting intended v2 coverage still validates. # TODO v2.

fields.description: Field extraction map. Each field lists ordered selectors (primary → fallbacks) per doc 18 §3.4. The runner tries each selector in order, then (when `llm_assisted` is set) an LLM-assisted pass, then dead-letters. A non-primary win flags the document `degraded: true`.

selectors.description: Ordered list (doc 18 §3.4): index 0 is the primary; later entries are fallbacks. The runner tries each in order, first non-empty match wins, and records which index matched so a fallback hit can flag `degraded: true`. An item is either a bare string (a CSS selector) or an object `{ selector, type }` to declare an XPath fallback alongside CSS primaries.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for a CSS selector (type defaults to `css`).

selector.description: The CSS selector or XPath expression.

type.description: Selector dialect. `css` (default) uses the soup CSS engine; `xpath` evaluates against the parsed tree (requires the ingestion extra's lxml).

attr.description: Optional element attribute to read instead of text content (e.g. `datetime`, `href`).

llm_assisted.description: When true, after every CSS/XPath selector fails the runner attempts LLM-assisted extraction for this field via the LLM gateway (doc 18 §2.3, §3.4). Opt-in per field so we never pay for an LLM call on a field that is acceptable to leave empty; an LLM win still flags the document `degraded: true`.

prompt_name.description: Prompt-registry seam (TODO E3): the named prompt the LLM-assisted pass uses for this field. The runner falls back to a built-in default extraction prompt when omitted or when the registry is unavailable.

signal_types.description: Signal types this recipe is expected to produce.
